registration_scope: Data source availability only inspected before this plan; no earnings prediction fits or performance seen. Historical vendor snapshot is not an archived contemporaneous estimate vintage.
hypothesis: Three fixed semiconductor EPS surprise features may add information to the SOXX/SOXL/cash index-enhancement information layer beyond the established BASE5; no strategy or portfolio optimization in this diagnostic.

source.limitations: Published affine basis differs slightly from serverQFQ; Jan2012 secondary quote uncertainty remains. Rebuilt history is not fresh out-of-sample evidence.

earnings_source.availability: Vendor reportedDate; conservative complete following trading-session close availability; no same-report-day use. Previous known event carried as state, not future backfill.
earnings_source.limitation: Vendor historical actual and estimated EPS may be retrospectively revised; no contemporaneous estimate-vintage archive. Fixed NVDA/AMD/INTC proxy is not a historical full semiconductor universe.
earnings_source.split_rounding_limitation: Old NVDA reported/estimated EPS can be about0.004-0.007 with three-decimal precision. Retrospective split adjustment and rounding may distort surprise; preserve registered values/formula/company set, do not repair numbers or substitute tickers.

features.availability: All market prices through signal close; decision convention 17:00 America/New_York. Earnings must satisfy source known-state timing.

labels.built_before_join: Use the complete canonical calendar; label available at open[t+6] 09:30 NewYork. Last six raw calendar rows remain explicitly unmatured, not silently filled.

training.model: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=10), multioutput cash5 and leverage5
training.availability: Remove last 20 prior signal rows, require actual feature and H5 label timestamps strictly before January1NewYork. All registered feature rows complete; no interior row dropping.

windows.year_basis: signal_year; retain final2022signals whose H5 result matures in early2023

uncertainty.scope: Pooled only; identical chronological paired stationary indices shared by both heads, all families, prior and cost events. Annual point metrics.
uncertainty.undefined: Every draw for a statistic must be finite, otherwise official interval undefined and its gate fails.
uncertainty.limitation: Conditional descriptive bootstrap on reused data; head-family adjustment does not correct prior adaptive research, retrospective vendor revision, or persistent quarterly event dependence.
uncertainty.historical_research_family_scope: Lower1.25percentile adjusts only the two fixed heads in this diagnostic; it does not control the full prior adaptive research history. All market history is reused, not a fresh holdout.

fees.net_log_event: target - head-specific hurdle; mask forecast strictly greater than hurdle
fees.cashflow_derivation: Start already holding SOXX. SOXX->cash->SOXX multiplies relative gross by A=(1-c)/(1+c); SOXX->SOXL->SOXX multiplies relative SOXL/SOXX gross by A squared.
fees.scope: Isolated overlapping five-session events; not a portfolio, not compounded or annualized.

gates.head_pass: For each fixed head fullIC>0, deltaIC>0, and MSEreduction>0 each in at least5of7years; pooled lower1.25percentile >0 for each at both blocks. Full forecast isolated net event mean lower1.25percentile >0 at10/25bp and bothblocks. Undefined/noevents fail.
gates.overall_information_gate: Both fixed heads must pass; neither head can be selected after seeing outcomes.
gates.failure_stop: Any information failure stops this fixed recipe. No reverse sign, model/horizon/threshold search. Positive information can only justify separately sourced PIT validation, not deployment.

artifact_policy.bootstrap_index_storage: Save seed, block, shape, indices_sha256 and pinned sampler_source_sha256; regenerate exact indices for independent audit. This changes archive representation only, not sampling, models, metrics or gates; registered before any financial fit.
